row.team_price_text: Creator: $33/mo ($390 billed yearly) for 1,000 subscribers, 2 users
row.evidence: Kit's pricing page lists Free (1 user), Creator (2 users) and Pro (unlimited users) with no SSO or SCIM; team members are invited manually under Settings > Team, and the help centre documents only password plus MFA sign-in.
row.notes: New row. ConvertKit rebranded to Kit (kit.com). Plans are priced by subscriber count, not per user: at 1,000 subscribers Creator is $33/mo ($390 billed yearly) and Pro $66/mo ($790 billed yearly); the Free plan has 1 user, Creator 2 users, Pro unlimited users. No SSO (SAML/OIDC), SCIM or team-member API is documented: the pricing page, the help-centre sitemap and the Kit API v4 reference (subscribers, tags, broadcasts, sequences, forms, webhooks, account info only) were searched. Team members (Admin or Editor role) are invited and removed by hand in Settings > Team. Status none by absence (confidence medium).

user_api.notes: The Kit API v4 covers subscribers, tags, sequences, broadcasts, forms, custom fields, purchases and webhooks. The only user-related call is GET /v4/account (the authenticated account and user); there are no team-member endpoints.
